name: Finland
paragraphs: The reference station is Helsinki Kaisaniemi, WMO 02978, height 3 m, the long-record observatory in the capital. Helsinki-Vantaa Airport has its own file and was not averaged in; Lapland is not this table. No official tipping page was opened on this pass, so that line is missing.

The highest average high in the table is 21.9 °C, in July. The lowest average low is -6.3 °C, in February. The wettest month by the precipitation column is August, at 81.4 mm, and the driest is April, at 34.1 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Helsinki Kaisaniemi, WMO 02978. Not Rovaniemi and not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Finland at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Visit Finland's guide to driving in Finland, on the official tourism site, lists the side of the road under "Drive on" as the right-hand side, together with the general speed limits and a reminder that headlights are required at all times.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Finland, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Euro and the code EUR for Finland.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Finland one row, Europe/Helsinki. zone1970.tab lists that zone on a row it shares with the Åland Islands (AX); the zone name is the same in both files.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The Finnish Immigration Service's Enter Finland e-services site. A direct request to migri.fi did not return the page on this pass. We do not restate a visa rule.
